question:
Which two numbers and which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

15 + 7 × 75 - 45 ÷ 25 = 147
solution:
According to the statement

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f29600a16d7a087891842e0f0733d7196de85d1eeb81c1c21ad1014e88bf611.png] 

Checking each option one by one:

Given equation: **15 + 7 × 75 - 45 ÷ 25 = 147**

**1) 15 and 75; + and ÷**

applying BODMAS

75 ÷ 7 × 15 - 45 + 25

= 10.71 × 15 - 45 + 25

= 160.65 - 45 + 25

= 185.65 - 45

**= 140.65 ≠ 147**

**2) 15 and 45; × and -**

applying BODMAS

45 + 7 - 75 ×
